material.finding: Administrator Operations & audit / Create shared workspace / Leavers accordions sit above search and the file list in every drive view; on 390px they push the list or empty state below the fold (two rows visible).
material.smallest_fix: Move the three admin panels to one administrator destination (a nav item or the existing Settings & DB page) so drive views open on search + list. Keep the contract: administrators only.

material.finding: The page h1 stays 'My files' in a folder and in Trash, while the list panel repeats 'My files' or carries a small 'Trash' heading; Upload sits in the in-card toolbar rather than the page header.
material.smallest_fix: Make the h1 the current location (workspace, Trash) with the breadcrumb under it; drop the duplicate panel title; put the single primary at the page header's right.

material.finding: Disabled 'Create app password' renders as a faded primary; with the enabled 2FA button that is two accent-filled buttons on the view. The centered narrow column starts at x≈384 instead of the shared x≈280 content edge, and 'In use' carries a stray dashed rule.
material.smallest_fix: Give disabled buttons a neutral, distinct style; keep one primary per view (make the 2FA enable the primary or a secondary); left-align .page-narrow to the content edge; remove the dashed rule.

material.finding: The empty folder shows two identical filled 'Upload files' buttons (toolbar and empty-state CTA).
material.smallest_fix: Make one of them secondary. The empty-state CTA can be the only filled one when the folder is empty.

material.finding: The Trash panel's tinted header band clips the card's top border and rounded corners.
material.smallest_fix: Apply the panel radius/overflow to the header band (or drop the tint) so the card border is continuous.

material.finding: Accent appears outside action/selection/focus: an orange folder icon tile and an orange 'Current' status pill.
material.smallest_fix: Neutral ink for folder icons; use a neutral or success-tinted pill for 'Current', as KyIdentity does for status.

optional.finding: Quota meter fill is invisible at 350 B of 10 GiB; the bar reads as an empty rule.
optional.smallest_fix: Give the fill a visible minimum width or drop the bar in favour of the text.

optional.finding: Login: the native theme select floats at the top right; the 'Security check verified.' box is styled like an input; the stamp icon's dark tile vanishes on the dark page.
optional.smallest_fix: Quiet inline status (no field border); keep the select but align it with page chrome; give the dark stamp a visible tile or border.

optional.finding: Preview: a bordered text frame nested in the dialog body; Download ~32px vs Close ~36px; on mobile Close drops to the action row.
optional.smallest_fix: Render the text directly on the dialog body; use 40px controls; keep Close in the title row.

optional.finding: Share: 'Done' is the filled primary while the real action, Create link, is secondary; on mobile the header Close is squeezed narrow.
optional.smallest_fix: Make Done secondary/neutral; give Close a fixed 40px square with flex-shrink 0.

optional.finding: In dark Appearance/Account, unselected radios render as filled grey dots.
optional.smallest_fix: Use an outlined, unfilled ring for unselected radios in dark themes.

optional.finding: Light theme selected nav uses accent-soft on My files but white on Appearance/Account; the account region repeats 'Administrator'; on phones the new-tab checkbox takes a header row on every page.
optional.smallest_fix: Use one selected treatment; show username + role; move the preference to Account.

progression.rule: Opus current overall, rounded half-up to 0.1, >= 8.0 accepts; not averaged with Sol or history; cohort shortfalls do not veto

verdict.reason: Opus covered-set overall is 7.2325, which rounds half-up to 7.2, below the 8.0 progression line. The shortfall comes mostly from M1-M3, which repeat across the 12 drive list views and the Account page. Dialogs, Appearance and login are already near 7.7-8.0. No target is forced: 9/10 remains unproven, and all behaviour gates are untested.
